hypothesis: Existing trend/momentum signals should outperform matched random directional markouts; no parameter change
holdout: After April 30, 2024 remains reserved from strategy-performance analysis until a future candidate is frozen; source-day dates define the existing approved data
method: Exact month x existing signal-time research session x direction; without replacement within each stratum, independent trials; no fallback. All horizon-eligible candidates, including actual signal bars and feature warmup rows, are eligible. Opposite directions may sample the same timestamp. No outcome filtering.
percentiles: p05/p95 nearest rank; actual percentile=100*(less+0.5*equal)/1000; descriptive, not a p-value
